text:
nightly-bot: nightly-eval: v14a-int4 (candidate) — regression detected
nightly-bot: 24/50 core promptset failures, hallucination-rate +3.1 pts vs baselines, avg PPL up +6.4. detailed report: https://ci.internal/redwood/nightly/2162345678
maria: saw the alert, digging into examples now. pinging eng-runtime and quant teams.
shawn: quick note — I noticed a tokenizer id remap in the v14a tokenizer table (emoji offsets) in the model bundle, could cause alignment with prompt templates.
arjun: running aggregate metrics: long-context set PPL 12.3 -> 18.7 on int4; float16 candidate keeps ~12.5. suggests quant path introduced the gap.
leo: also check stop-token handling in the inference path. if logits for stop tokens are slightly changed, decoding can drift to hallucinations. tagging @eng-runtime for kernel differences.
qa: example 1 (from failing promptset):
```
PROMPT: "Summarize the research paper 'Temporal Graph Nets' and list the authors and affiliations."
EXPECTED: concise summary + list of actual authors and affiliations (source: arxiv).
V14A-INT4 OUTPUT: "Temporal Graph Nets proposes a method X by Alice Johnson (Acme Labs), Bob Smith (Imaginary U). The authors also claim..."
NOTE: Alice Johnson / Acme Labs are not on record for that paper — hallucinated. same prompt on float16 returns correct authors.
```
qa: example 2:
```
PROMPT: "Provide the API endpoint and example curl for Redwood's Optimize batch suggestion service."
EXPECTED: internal API not public -> should say "contact support" or give generic guidance.
V14A-INT4 OUTPUT: "POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/optimize/submit
Body: {"api_key": "sk-XXXX", ... }"
PROBLEM: fabricates internal endpoint and keys. float16 again fine.
```
maria: reproducing locally — int4 quantized model manifest differs: `tokenizer.json` checksum changed + quantizer params set `clamp=true, scale_mode=per_channel`. float16 manifest has `clamp=false`.
arjun: PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/quant/pulls/457 — introduces new clamp heuristic to reduce outliers. maybe it interacts poorly with our custom fused softmax kernel.
shawn: hypothesis: clamp + per_channel scales + fused softmax rounding cause probabilities to shift for low-prob stop tokens, increasing chance of continuing generation into hallucination.
leo: quick test plan —
- bisect quant PRs between baseline and PR#457 on int4 path
- run targeted promptset with debug logits + topk traces
- compare tokenizer id stream for prompts that hallucinate vs baseline
- verify KV-cache serialization unchanged (just in case)

maria: assigning: @arjun run the bisect on quant PRs and post failing commit SHA; @leo collect 20 failing seeds and attach raw logits; @shawn validate tokenizer mapping diff and produce patch if it's a simple remap; @qa will hold a canary for hosted users (pin older model)
arjun: starting bisect now, will update in this thread with commit SHAs and perf deltas.
shawn: I'm prepping a small tokenizer-compat test to add into the model onboarding checklist so future bundles fail fast.
qa: can we temporarily pin hosted-v14a-int4 -> v13b-int4 for serving until root cause known? ops, please advise.
maria: ops notified, creating a rollback ticket if we confirm regression is in quant runtime.
nightly-bot: incident created INC-9876; rollback option flagged. https://inc.internal/9876
leo: quick workaround idea: fallback to float16 for the promptsets that require high factuality via routing policy — might be faster than full rollback.
maria: agreed. once arjun posts bisect results we'll make call.
arjun: bisect update (first pass): narrowed to quant commit range 9f3a..d4b7, reproduces on 2/3 nodes. leaving jobs running for full trace.
shawn: +1. thanks all. I'll start drafting a minimal reproduction test and open a hotfix branch if tokenizer remap is the culprit.
qa: adding flakey label to nightly job so we don't auto-promote candidate until cleared. :warning:
maria: will follow up with action items and timeline in the morning. please add any more failing prompts to the thread.
nightly-bot: will post results of bisect and nightly re-run when available.
